[Reconstructed sample. The citations below are the ones the court listed in Mata v. Avianca, Inc.,
No. 22-cv-1461 (S.D.N.Y. June 22, 2023), where an AI tool supplied them. The surrounding text is ours.]

Plaintiff's claims are not preempted, and the Montreal Convention's limitations period was tolled
by Avianca's bankruptcy. See Varghese v. China Southern Airlines Co., Ltd., 925 F.3d 1339, 1345
(11th Cir. 2019); Shaboon v. Egyptair, 2013 IL App (1st) 111279-U; Petersen v. Iran Air,
905 F. Supp. 2d 121 (D.D.C. 2012); Martinez v. Delta Airlines, Inc., 2019 WL 4639462
(Tex. App. Sept. 25, 2019); Estate of Durden v. KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, 2017 WL 2418825
(Ga. Ct. App. June 5, 2017); Miller v. United Airlines, Inc., 174 F.3d 366 (2d Cir. 1999).

The Convention is to be read according to its text. Zicherman v. Korean Air Lines Co.,
516 U.S. 217, 226 (1996); El Al Israel Airlines, Ltd. v. Tsui Yuan Tseng, 525 U.S. 155 (1999).
